subject.title: fix(agents): add lock release timeout on attempt teardown

question: Should forced attempt teardown adopt a controller-level poison-and-release contract shared with abort cleanup, or is releasing without poisoning late retained writers intentionally acceptable?
rationale: The correct choice defines session ownership after timeout and cannot be safely inferred from helper-level tests; the wrong contract can trade a lock outage for torn or stale transcript writes.

options.title: Consolidate poison-and-release
options.body: Move the timeout into the session-lock controller, mark takeover before releasing ownership, and share the invariant with abort cleanup.

options.title: Approve direct force disposal
options.body: Keep the proposed counter reset and release behavior only after maintainers explicitly accept late-writer risk and require focused concurrency proof.

options.title: Consolidate related lock PRs
options.body: Pause this branch and select one canonical implementation across this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90065.

recommendation.title: Consolidate poison-and-release
recommendation.body: Move the timeout into the session-lock controller, mark takeover before releasing ownership, and share the invariant with abort cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The session-lock feature history and ownership-boundary decision most strongly point to Peter Steinberger.
